title: Transcatheter Interatrial Shunt Device for the Treatment of Heart Failure With Preserved Ejection Fraction (REDUCE LAP-HF I): A Phase 2, Randomized, Sham-Controlled Trial
enrollment: HF with raised exercise filling pressures
primary_endpoint: Pulmonary capillary wedge pressure during exercise at 1 month
primary_result_as_reported: Greater reduction across exercise stages vs sham (P=0.028); peak PCWP comparisons not statistically significant (P=0.14)
verification_status: Source-linked abstract draft; full-text and independent verification pending

title: Effect of Inorganic Nitrite vs Placebo on Exercise Capacity Among Patients With Heart Failure With Preserved Ejection Fraction: The INDIE-HFpEF Randomized Clinical Trial
primary_result_as_reported: 13.5 vs 13.7 mL/kg/min; treatment difference -0.20 (95% CI -0.56 to 0.16), P=.27
verification_status: Source-linked abstract draft; full-text and independent verification pending

title: Randomized Evaluation of Heart Failure With Preserved Ejection Fraction Patients With Acute Heart Failure and Dopamine: The ROPA-DOP Trial
intervention_or_exposure: Continuous IV furosemide, bolus IV furosemide, with/without low-dose dopamine
primary_endpoint: Percent change in creatinine at 72 hours
primary_result_as_reported: Continuous infusion associated with greater creatinine increase than bolus (16.01% vs 4.62%, P=.02); no detectable dopamine benefit (P=.33)
verification_status: Source-linked abstract draft; full-text and independent verification pending
limitations_or_followup: Multiple treatment contrasts; do not simplify into a single risk ratio

title: Effect of exercise training in patients with chronotropic incompetence and heart failure with preserved ejection fraction: the TRAINING-HR randomized clinical trial
primary_endpoint: Change in peak VO2 at 12 weeks
primary_result_as_reported: Aerobic plus higher-resistance training versus recommendations: +4.0 mL/kg/min (95% CI 2.9 to 5.1; P<.001)
verification_status: Source-linked abstract draft; full-text and independent verification pending
limitations_or_followup: Four-arm study; result corresponds to one specified treatment contrast

title: Novel Controlled Metabolic Accelerator for Obesity-Related HFpEF: The HuMAIN-HFpEF Randomized Clinical Trial
primary_endpoint: Change in body weight at 19 weeks
primary_result_as_reported: Between-group difference -2.86 kg (95% CI -4.68 to -1.04), P=.003
verification_status: Source-linked abstract draft; full-text and independent verification pending
limitations_or_followup: Peak VO2 and quality-of-life improvements were not statistically significant

title: Iron Repletion in Heart Failure With Preserved Ejection Fraction: The IRONMET-HFpEF Randomized Trial
primary_endpoint: Change in peak VO2 at 12 weeks
primary_result_as_reported: Least-squares mean difference 1.1 mL/kg/min (95% CI 0.2 to 1.9), P=.02
verification_status: Source-linked abstract draft; full-text and independent verification pending
limitations_or_followup: Published 2026-11-08 ahead of print; follow-up 12 weeks

title: Effectiveness of tirzepatide in patients with HFpEF using a target trial emulation retrospective cohort study
primary_result_as_reported: Association HR 0.52 for composite; CI not in abstract summary
verification_status: Source-linked abstract draft; full-text and independent verification pending
limitations_or_followup: Observational association, not randomized causal efficacy

title: Performance of the HFpEF-ABA, H2FPEF, and HFA-PEFF Algorithms in Heart Failure With Preserved Ejection Fraction: A Participant-Level Pooled Analysis of Randomized Clinical Trials
parent_trial_or_context: HFpEF diagnostic scores across five parent trials
enrollment: HFpEF in CHARM-Preserved, I-PRESERVE, TOPCAT-Americas, PARAGON-HF, DELIVER
primary_endpoint: CV death or HF hospitalization risk association
primary_result_as_reported: High vs low/intermediate HFpEF-ABA: HR 1.75 (95% CI 1.62 to 1.89); association, not treatment efficacy
verification_status: Source-linked abstract draft; full-text and independent verification pending
limitations_or_followup: Not a new independent randomized cohort; links five older parent trials

title: The Spironolactone Initiation Registry Randomized Interventional Trial in Heart Failure with Preserved Ejection Fraction (SPIRRIT-HFpEF): Rationale and design
primary_endpoint: Planned total CV deaths and HF hospitalizations
primary_result_as_reported: No clinical outcome results: design paper only
verification_status: Source-linked abstract draft; full-text and independent verification pending
limitations_or_followup: Projected approximately 2400; not a completed outcomes paper

title: Superior Cardiorenal Protection With Tirzepatide Over Dulaglutide in Heart Failure With Preserved Ejection Fraction: A Large-Scale Propensity Score–Matched Real-World Analysis
enrollment: Matched HFpEF cohorts from electronic health records
primary_result_as_reported: 1-year all-cause mortality HR 0.66 (95% CI 0.59 to 0.74); secondary reported association
verification_status: Source-linked abstract draft; full-text and independent verification pending
limitations_or_followup: Matched 24,305 per arm; observational, not head-to-head randomized trial
